scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @saloon/server" "npm run dev -w @saloon/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @saloon/web && npm run build -w @saloon/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @saloon/web && npm run bundle:server && electron apps/desktop/main.cjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build -w @saloon/web && npm run bundle:server && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build -w @saloon/web && npm run bundle:server && SALOON_SMOKE=1 SALOON_HEADLESS=1 electron apps/desktop/main.cjs
